title: Nausea & Vomiting (Chhardi / Emesis) — Dual-System Clinical Monograph
content:
Condition: Nausea & Vomiting (Emesis / Chhardi).
Allopathic Pharmacology: Ondansetron 4mg (5-HT3 receptor antagonist) or Domperidone 10mg taken 15-30 minutes before food. Oral Rehydration Solution sip by sip to maintain electrolytes.
Ayurvedic Formulations: Mayurapuccha Bhasma (125mg with honey), Eladi Vati (chewable cardamom tablet), Dadimavaleha (Pomegranate herbal jam 5g).
Home Remedies: Fresh Ginger slices with rock salt and lemon juice, Cardamom & Clove infusion, Pomegranate juice sips, Smelling fresh lemon peel.
Precautions: Stay hydrated in small, frequent sips rather than large gulps. If vomiting is accompanied by severe abdominal rigidity or head trauma, seek immediate emergency care.
